people.name: Dan
people.line: Israelite tribe; city in northern Israel; originally called Laish/Leshem.

people.name: Micah
people.line: A man from Ephraim who set up idolatrous worship.

translations.web: The children of Dan went their way; and when Micah saw that they were too strong for him, he turned and went back to his house.
translations.bsb: So the Danites went on their way, and Micah turned to go back home, because he saw that they were too strong for him.
translations.kjv: And the children of Dan went their way: and when Micah saw that they were too strong for him, he turned and went back unto his house.
translations.asv: And the children of Dan went their way: and when Micah saw that they were too strong for him, he turned and went back unto his house.
